# Data Commons Docs

> Data Commons Documentation. This file routes agents to the freshest authoritative docs for APIs, MCP, custom deployments, SQL, and reference material.

Links below point to GitHub raw Markdown on `master` for the freshest agent-readable content.

Use `Query Data With Agents` for MCP setup, hosted MCP usage, Gemini CLI integration, or self-hosted MCP.
Use `Query Data Programmatically` for REST, Python, Pandas, Sheets, Web Components, and BigQuery.
Use `Build A Custom Data Commons` for deployment, config, imports, and custom instance tooling.
Use `Reference And Data Coverage` for concepts, glossary, datasets, and background material.

## Start Here

- [How to use Data Commons](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/datacommonsorg/docsite/master/index.md): Use when the user is not sure which Data Commons surface to start with.
- [What is Data Commons?](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/datacommonsorg/docsite/master/what_is.md): Use when the user needs a conceptual introduction to Data Commons.
- [Get support](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/datacommonsorg/docsite/master/support.md): Use when the user needs support channels or feedback paths.

## Query Data With Agents

- [MCP - Query data interactively with an AI agent](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/datacommonsorg/docsite/master/mcp/index.md): Use when the user asks what the Data Commons MCP is or whether agents can query Data Commons.
- [Use MCP tools](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/datacommonsorg/docsite/master/mcp/run_tools.md): Use when the user wants to connect Gemini CLI or another MCP-capable agent to the hosted Data Commons MCP.
- [Run an MCP Server](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/datacommonsorg/docsite/master/mcp/host_server.md): Use when the user wants to self-host the MCP server or connect a custom client.
